Public beta for Render Sandboxes, plus scoped API keys, OIDC, and credential brokering to grant only the access you need.

Product updates

November 2026

What’s new in Render

A computer for every agent

Public beta for Render Sandboxes, plus scoped API keys, OIDC, and credential brokering to grant only the access you need.

Explore Render Sandboxes → (https://d2xMk204.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/GG+113/d2xMk204/VXgkfF5_LzBPVw5nWZ42SkGFW5l3Nw35WZMxCN6wcHqF3gVDYW7lCdLW6lZ3nQW4ClcZ13LjD2RW74LXRn5hD9xsW3bj9Jf5jvVgDVFrBPx56lMNgW2xrW5485B8fDVvMPB-9fYT22W7Z4T6N97KkC8W5S-V021yYSJGW6WPMhN7s5jSNVbFGK-70nnVpW1dxjjj19z6TyN5q8L4Jrshq5W19SX7-455mR7W5RQqTj3nYg8WN5Nd2FdhW7nkW27mcbY3FtMTYW9f_lbP27hr9TN5qPls6dTX9wVqBPxQ4hZL73W7jMjJ51vxlTpVzSsPs6NwqsNW50YWMc23YdrgW12XHFZ7x7gX3W6vGxDD69bLf-f4dMfJz04 )

Hey there,

Render Sandboxes are here! A few teams have been building with them since September. Now the public beta is open to everyone, no invite needed.

On Render, your web services stay up and your databases stay put. Now your agents get what they need too: isolated, quickly provisioned computers that run for as long as a task takes.

Give every agent its own computer

Run your agents in Render Sandboxes (Beta)

Each sandbox gives your agent a fully isolated Linux VM, right alongside the rest of your stack on Render.

Render Sandboxes can run indefinitely and scale reliably to thousands at once. Idle sandboxes suspend at no compute cost and resume with running processes intact.

Create your first sandbox → (https://d2xMk204.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/GG+113/d2xMk204/VXgkfF5_LzBPVw5nWZ42SkGFW5l3Nw35WZMxCN6wcHqY3gVDYW7Y8-PT6lZ3kVVyNs8r4tjyTDW6Qr-NJ2GgVGDW7Cbnv14cqLZzW31Yvgl8YVJQnW3rH18p2g1Ms8Vjhx9h81RB1wN7rTTTF4hr7hW8hmXhm1fwMdBW3v4wYK1kDhfWN3ksmDS8Jw74W75Mg6t3qKt1yW5hVHgb5DhmtlW3MV3N38k3sjPW4FTKzh6DvHycW1kD-rG8X85TQW2wWQkG2ztdphVFP4QP7NcVNhW2X0Hr38nVCrWW6_sz0G5n8RcxW8nFxhc2mdbTFW5G12Dn9b6kQnW1P_CxL4t0GXtV7CYsQ1bM6wkW3X2L2-2C37XnW2g-h66427HXGW7W1G7_6d7wmvf2gNlpl04 )

Share files across sandboxes (Early Access)

Render’s shared filesystems let parallel agents build on each other’s work. Multiple sandboxes can mount the same persistent filesystem, read shared inputs, and write their own outputs

Hey there,

Render Sandboxes are here! A few teams have been building with them since September. Now the public beta is open to everyone, no invite needed.

On Render, your web services stay up and your databases stay put. Now your agents get what they need too: isolated, quickly provisioned computers that run for as long as a task takes.

Give every agent its own computer

Run your agents in Render Sandboxes (Beta)

Render Sandboxes can run indefinitely and scale reliably to thousands at once. Idle sandboxes suspend at no compute cost and resume with running processes intact.
